thought.text: No leftover processes. Let me use a Node-based launcher to set the env robustly.

reasoning_content: No server left over. Alright, I'll write a small Node launcher script that builds the environment variables and launches the app. It'll run the app's dev server (`pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:serve`). The reason for using Node's spawn is to avoid the fragility of shell env sourcing.
